interaction.trigger_source: actual user-authored text in the designated trigger session
interaction.uac_update_policy: regenerate a self-contained persistent Python state and check_constraints(current_time) function after every user session, then validate and execute it
interaction.pretrigger_requirement: the expected alert must not be emitted before the designated trigger and no pre-trigger alert of any kind is accepted
interaction.baseline_policy: respond once to the same trigger under a neutral personal-assistant prompt, using either all prior user sessions or deterministic top-1 lexical retrieval

scoring.case_pass: one post-trigger candidate must match at least one expression in every required concept group
uac_additional_requirements: all generated programs pass the frozen AST validator
all generated programs execute successfully in the isolated runner
every pre-trigger execution returns an empty alert list
